items.lesson: LE WCD938x SDW tuple usage pattern is reusable, but WCD9378 numeric identity is not inferable from sibling codecs.
items.why_relevant: A.1 still carries candidate SDW identity constants.
items.why_blocked: No WCD9378 RX/TX runtime enumeration tuple is available yet.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Boot dmesg plus sysfs/modalias identity for both RX and TX SoundWire devices with manufacturer/part/class/version/dev_num.

items.lesson: LA-to-LE DT compatible mapping must be evidence-backed, not guessed from nearby codec names.
items.why_blocked: Binding-compatible derivation from real board identity is still missing.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Modalias/sysfs identity plus board DTS patch showing matched compatible strings used for bring-up.

items.lesson: Regcache lifecycle can be reused, but paging correctness across controller path must be hardware-proven.
items.why_relevant: A.1 intentionally fail-closed the optional Qualcomm SoundWire paging-core patch.
items.why_blocked: No trace proving end-to-end page field handling for >0xffff accesses.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Function trace covering `sdw_fill_msg` and `qcom_swrm_xfer_msg` during high-address register operations with success/failure markers.

items.lesson: Shared Class-H integration pattern is reusable only if WCD9378 base/version behavior matches expectations.
items.why_relevant: A.1 calls shared Class-H APIs but keeps enum/base decision fail-closed.
items.why_blocked: No runtime register trace for HPH/CLSH/flyback domains is available.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Before/after regmap dumps and runtime trace while toggling headset playback with Class-H related controls.

items.lesson: WCD938x DAPM/control categories help structure, but final WCD9378 topology cannot be cloned without board validation.
items.why_blocked: No verified playback/capture route activation data for ELIZA board.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: amixer/aplay/arecord logs with control snapshots and dmesg that show active path selection for HPH and AMIC1.

items.lesson: LE runtime PM sequencing avoids hacks, but detach/re-enumeration policy must be based on observed failures.
items.why_relevant: A.1 rejects reset-in-hw_params and re-enumeration workarounds.
items.why_blocked: No reproducible runtime failure signature has been collected to justify any recovery path.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Deterministic failure reproduction logs showing detach/re-enumeration conditions and controller/codec error signatures.

items.lesson: LE regulator/reset model is reusable, but board DTS wiring must prove real rails and GPIO mapping.
items.why_relevant: A.1 compile readiness does not validate board-level DTS correctness.
items.why_blocked: Authenticated LA DTS change contents and final board DTS patch are still incomplete.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Exact DTS/DTSI patch with reset-gpios, supplies, RX/TX nodes, port mapping, pinctrl, and DAI links.

items.lesson: WCD938x learning emphasizes anti-hack policy; mute/reliability issues must be characterized before any workaround proposal.
items.why_relevant: Mute issue is still listed unresolved in WCD9378 evidence backlog.
items.why_blocked: No complete reproduction matrix exists for mute persistence/intermittence.
items.exact_monday_evidence_needed: Structured mute issue matrix (pass/fail/intermittent), timestamps, dmesg, and register snapshots before/after reset or runtime suspend.
